title: AFD CommandError
description: Structured error carried by failed CommandResult, BatchResult, StepResult and ErrorChunk wire payloads (spec/schema/README.md).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, usually from the shared catalog in spec/error-codes.md.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

suggestion.description: Actionable recovery guidance for the caller. Optional on the wire; commands and engines should always set it.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same call may succeed. Absence is read as false.

recovery.description: The step the suggestion describes, in a form a program can follow and a test can check (spec/recovery.md). The prose suggestion stays for people and models.

details.description: Structured debugging context for the caller.

cause.description: The CommandError that caused this error. Native exceptions never cross the wire.

allOf.description: A retry recovery is only for a transient failure.
Nothing makes a stopped call succeed, so it is not retryable.

kind.description: call another command, fix-input and call again, retry unchanged, an external step, or stop.

command.description: call only: the command to call next, by its registered name.

input.description: call: arguments for command. fix-input: replacement values for the failed call's top-level input members. Never an acknowledgement (confirm), approval or credential.

needs.description: call and fix-input: top-level input fields the caller must choose.

thenRetry.description: call only: once command succeeds, repeat the failed call unchanged.

afterMs.description: retry only: wait at least this many milliseconds first; at most 2^53 - 1, the largest integer every language reads exactly.

allOf.description: A fix-input recovery says what to change.
